preconditions.description: The number of rows M is between 1 and 2 inclusive.
The number of columns N is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The range of random integers K is between 1 and 100,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(M, int) and isinstance(N, int) and isinstance(K, int)
preconditions.description: M, N, and K are integers.

postconditions.description: The output is a single line containing one integer.
The output integer is the expected number of strongly connected components modulo 998244353.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == (sum(expected_scc_count(matrix) for matrix in all_possible_matrices(M, N, K)) * pow(K**(M*N), -1, 998244353)) % 998244353
postconditions.description: The output equals the expected number of SCCs computed as the sum of SCC counts over all K^(M*N) possible matrices, multiplied by the modular inverse of the total number of matrices, modulo 998244353.
